False positive. CVE-2022-31691 is a deserialisation RCE in Spring Tools 4 for Eclipse and the VSCode/Theia Spring Boot extensions (the IDE tooling), CPE-mismatched to spring-boot-devtools. Unrelated artifact, and devtools is developmentOnly so it is absent from the production runtime. file name: spring-boot-devtools-*.jar

CVE-2026-54285 (unbounded memory allocation in W3C Baggage propagation) is an advisory against the npm package @opentelemetry/core, CPE-matched onto the unrelated Java artifacts io.opentelemetry:opentelemetry-{api,common,context}.
